verdict_reason: The commodity vocabulary rename is correct, but the fixtures keep a speciesLatinName array shape that production never stores, pair horse code 0101 with a bison species, and two titles over-claim 'every'

todos.issue: speciesLatinName is fed as an array ([BOS_TAURUS]) at lines 85, 318 and 325, but as a scalar string at lines 223, 236, 241, 277 and 282; production stores one Latin name per line as a string (seedLine in features/commodities/search/actions/commit-selection.js, and happy-path.json has "speciesLatinName": "Bos taurus"). The array shape is carried over from the old speciesSelection multi-select, so the round-trip and pass-through tests prove a shape the pages never write
todos.fix: Must: every speciesLatinName value in this file has the shape the commodities pages store (a single Latin-name string per line). One way: replace [BOS_TAURUS] with BOS_TAURUS at lines 85, 318 and 325 and update the expectation at 325 to { line0: BOS_TAURUS }

todos.issue: Fixture data is incoherent: line 1 pairs commodity code '0101' (horses, HORSES_CODE in services/commodities/rules.js) with species 'Bison bison', which fixtures/commodities.json lists under '0102' (cattle), and its ear tags are still named 'horse-1'/'horse-2' (lines 222-227, 239-245; also 'Bison bison' on a line with no code at 277/282). A reader learning the bridge from this test learns a commodity/species pairing the service would refuse
todos.fix: Must: each commodity line in these fixtures pairs a code with a species that code holds in fixtures/commodities.json, and identifier values do not name a different animal. One way: keep line1 as '0102' with BISON_BISON and rename the ear tags 'bison-1'/'bison-2', or use a horse Latin name (e.g. Equus caballus) for the '0101' line

todos.issue: Titles over-claim 'every': 'Should round-trip every commodity code exactly' (line 107) now loops four hand-picked codes ('0102', '0101', '01063300', '01061900') out of the many in fixtures/commodities.json - the old list was the whole picker vocabulary, so the rename made the title untrue; 'Should leave every other field untouched' (line 312) asserts five named fields
todos.fix: Must: each title states what its assertions prove and no more. One way: 'Should round-trip a commodity code of any length exactly' (or loop the codes from the commodities fixture to keep 'every'), and 'Should store purpose, certification, transport, transited countries and species as given'

todos.issue: Banner and inline comments carry rationale and describe other modules, against the house comment rules: lines 288-291 ('the manifest's gates compare the same values the pages store. The animal count is the one coercion' - describes the manifest and pages, and counts), 336-341 ('Both model the same nested topology ... (like commodityLines)'), 406-409, 175-176 ('The evaluator infers group instances from descendant storage ... a known blind spot'), 141-142 and 437-438; the line 288-291 banner sits directly over the commodity tests this PR edits
todos.fix: Must: no comment in the file explains rationale or describes code outside the lines beneath it; what the tests prove is said by describe and it titles. One way: delete these comments, fold any needed meaning into the describe/it titles (e.g. 'Should not represent an empty collection' without '(documented)'), and move the evaluator blind-spot rationale to the repo docs or behaviour spec
